meta.name: linkedin-ads-campaign-setup
meta.description: Set up LinkedIn Ads campaign architecture with proper funnel layers, retargeting segments, and pre-launch checklists. Use when the user asks about LinkedIn campaign structure, funnel architecture, retargeting setup, campaign organization, LinkedIn Ads launch checklist, or how to structure LinkedIn ad campaigns. Triggers on "campaign setup", "campaign structure", "funnel architecture", "retargeting setup", "launch checklist", "campaign organization", "LinkedIn campaign". Do NOT use for bidding (use bidding), targeting (use audiences), or creative (use creative/copy).

copy.tagline: 规划 LinkedIn 广告活动架构，包含漏斗与重定向策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要系统化搭建 LinkedIn 广告活动结构

howto.what: Claude 会帮助搭建 LinkedIn 广告的漏斗结构（冷、温、热三层），设置再营销人群与时间窗口，提供启动检查清单和测试框架。
howto.when: 当用户询问 LinkedIn 广告结构、漏斗架构、再营销设置、启动清单或如何组织广告活动时触发。

say.text: 帮我搭建 LinkedIn 广告的三层漏斗。
say.note: Claude 会给出分层的预算分配和内容建议。

say.text: 我需要 LinkedIn 广告的启动检查清单。
say.note: Claude 会列出包括受众、预算、UTM 等步骤。

say.text: 如何设置 LinkedIn 的再营销人群？
say.note: Claude 会说明不同时间窗口的受众和内容。

howto.what_en: Claude helps architect LinkedIn Ads campaign structure with a three-layer funnel (cold, warm, hot), sets up retargeting segments with windows, provides a pre-launch checklist, and outlines a testing framework.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users ask about LinkedIn campaign structure, funnel architecture, retargeting setup, launch checklist, or how to organize ad campaigns.

say_en.text: Set up a LinkedIn Ads three-layer funnel for me.
say_en.note: Claude will provide budget allocation and content suggestions per layer.

say_en.text: I need a LinkedIn Ads pre-launch checklist.
say_en.note: Claude will list steps including audiences, budget, UTM, etc.

say_en.text: How do I set up retargeting audiences on LinkedIn?
say_en.note: Claude explains audiences and content by time window.
